D10

10.1" Compact Desktop POS Terminal

Android 1110.1" TouchscreenCompact FootprintAffordable

The D10 is a compact and affordable desktop POS terminal with a 10.1-inch touchscreen display. Running Android 11 on a quad-core processor with 2GB RAM and 32GB storage, it is perfect for small businesses, takeaway restaurants, and service counters. Its small footprint saves valuable counter space while providing full POS functionality.
